blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla described the student behind the shooting incident at Banga National High School in South Cotabato as a good kid that got exposed to the deep web and Satanism. The student, whom he called by the name “Lucky,” was an honor student who had a girlfriend and friends, said Remulla in an ambush interview at the Batasang Pambansa complex. He also said the student was not bullied and had never been a bully.
